items.headline: Palantir shares slump despite earnings beat and raised guidance
items.summary: Palantir reported better-than-expected quarterly sales and earnings and raised full-year sales guidance, but its stock fell as investors focused on valuation and largely flat order backlogs.

items.headline: Nvidia falls as AI valuations and data-center policy risks pressure the trade
items.summary: AP reported that Nvidia declined as AI-related stocks faced concerns about elevated prices and possible restrictions or delays affecting additional data-center construction.

items.headline: CoreWeave drops as data-center and AI-infrastructure concerns intensify
items.summary: CoreWeave fell sharply amid broader pressure on AI-related shares and investor concerns about data-center expansion and AI valuations.

items.headline: AI data-center builders sell off after election results
items.summary: StockTitan reported steep intraday declines among data-center infrastructure companies, including Modine, Hut 8, Sterling Infrastructure, Cipher Digital and Solaris Energy Infrastructure, after Democrats won Congress and the Texas governor race.

items.headline: Hut 8 declines amid Texas data-center concerns
items.summary: Hut 8 was among the hardest-hit AI data-center names in StockTitan's reported 11:12 a.m. ET snapshot, with concerns focused on Texas development and power capacity.

items.headline: Amazon rises while data-center builders sell off
items.summary: StockTitan reported Amazon higher alongside other large technology companies even as specialized AI data-center builders declined sharply, highlighting divergent market treatment of hyperscalers and infrastructure developers.
